rationale: Re-review after fixes. CR-001 resolved: rollback assigns workflow.yaml_config before update() and passes yaml_config_history in a single update() call; service and router tests cover list, rollback, validation, and auth. Follow-up commits removed the broken autouse fixture that patched non-existent WorkflowService._update_workflow_history (CI setup ERROR on 46f3bfd3). Rollback now re-parses execution config, validates MCP/marketplace/workflow before persist, and restores yaml_config on validation failure.

finding_status.notes: workflow.yaml_config set from target revision; workflow.update(yaml_config_history=[new_entry, *history]) only; tests assert yaml_config on object and history kwargs.

business_review.criterion: GET /v1/workflows/{id}/versions returns revision list with total_revisions, workflow_name, workflow_id
POST /v1/workflows/{id}/versions/rollback rolls back to target revision using revision_index
business_review.notes: yaml_config restored from history entry; parse_execution_config and validation run before update().

business_review.criterion: Rollback prepends current config as new audit history entry (immutable-append)
Auth: READ for list, WRITE for rollback
400 on empty history, 400 on out-of-range index

standards_review.notes: Apache 2.0 on new and modified Python files.
workflow_version_service uses from __future__ import annotations and str | None.
Auth on endpoints; MCP access validation on restored config; no secrets introduced.
